description: This file contains implementation of positional encoding classes for transformers, including sine-based and learned position embeddings, used in object detection models. It defines classes PositionEmbeddingSine and PositionEmbeddingLearned, along with a function build_position_encoding.

classes.name: PositionEmbeddingSine
classes.description: A sine-based positional encoding module for transformer models, adapted for image data, similar to the original 'Attention Is All You Need' positional encoding but extended for image tensors.

classes.name: PositionEmbeddingLearned
classes.description: A learned positional encoding module that creates trainable embeddings for image rows and columns, used as an alternative to sine-based encoding.

methods.name: PositionEmbeddingSine.__init__
methods.description: Initializes positional sine encoding with parameters for feature dimensions, temperature, normalization, and scale.

methods.name: PositionEmbeddingSine.forward
methods.description: Computes sine-position encoding for input tensors, considering masks and spatial dimensions.

methods.name: PositionEmbeddingLearned.__init__
methods.description: Initializes learned positional encoding with embedding layers for rows and columns.

methods.name: PositionEmbeddingLearned.reset_parameters
methods.description: Initializes the weight of the embedding layers uniformly.

methods.name: PositionEmbeddingLearned.forward
methods.description: Generates learned positional encodings for the input tensor based on its spatial dimensions.

methods.name: build_position_encoding(args)
methods.description: Factory function to create a positional encoding object based on provided arguments.
